candidate.answerReason: The center distance is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs 24 and 14-4=10, giving 26 inches.

methods.label: Construct a right triangle
methods.explanation:
A straight portion of the taut belt is tangent to both pulleys. Let its contact points be \(A\) and \(B\), and let the corresponding centers be \(O_1\) and \(O_2\), with radii \(O_1A=14\) and \(O_2B=4\). The given straight belt segment has length \(AB=24\).

Each radius to a contact point is perpendicular to the belt. Because the belt is uncrossed, the centers lie on the same side of this tangent. Through \(O_2\), draw a line parallel to \(AB\), meeting \(O_1A\) at \(C\). Then \(ABO_2C\) is a rectangle, so \(AC=4\) and \(CO_2=24\). Consequently,
\[O_1C=14-4=10.\]
Triangle \(O_1CO_2\) is right at \(C\), and its hypotenuse is the desired center distance. By the Pythagorean theorem,
\[O_1O_2=\sqrt{10^2+24^2}=\sqrt{676}=26.\]
The distance is \(\boxed{26\text{ inches}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
